# Reviewable model proposal

## What you will review
The proposed Task, Input/feedback, Actor, Evidence, state-transition, review submission/outcome and check-attempt types in the Data models view. For each: typed fields, optionality, relations/cardinality, owned invariants and mutators, and changes from the current model. The proposal is isolated from the live runtime; inspecting or type-checking it does not install it or approve it.

## Work
Use the preceding, reviewed model inspection surface to compare proposed declarations with the current contracts and their runtime constraints. Prefer existing compiler inspection, tree, graph and node-editor components. Native source is the authority; no parallel handwritten UI schema. Explicitly show rules that are runtime-only or not yet implemented. Include stable links to each reviewed model element.

## Decisions for review
Parent placement aggregation across mixed children; optional titles by task type; assignment; readiness versus acceptance; correction/resubmission inside the same task; immutable attempt evidence; cancellation and abandonment; independent reviewer outcomes and task completion.

## Deliverable
A complete state table and proposed native types with executable invariant examples and typed mutation signatures. Demonstrate valid/invalid examples including rejected review without deadlock, queuing descendants, stale check evidence and already accepted boundaries.

## Boundary
This stage prepares a proposed model and its inspection. It does not change live task execution semantics. Implement the agreed behavior only in the following implementation stage after the named model review passes.
